Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog: When you open a "For Sale" placard for a plot that is selling via lottery, a panel now appears on its right showing how many people have entered and your chance of winning. If you already have an entry, your lottery number is shown and the odds count you as one of the participants. The panel also lists the plot size, price, who can buy it and when entries close. The "Copy sale" button copies the plot as a short line, for example "Lich Mist W17 P45 -> 44". This needs the "Show ward info panel" setting turned on.
